name: AMOEBA
full_name: Agentic Mesh-Overlay with Encrypted Biometric Authentication
tagline: The love letter to RustDesk. Take what was given. Give back MORE.
atlas_hugged: The good Samaritan coming back to pay ALL that is owed.

organization.why_protoKarya: 'first cell' — AMOEBA is the simplest free-living organism

what_we_give_back.zk_identity: Every relay connection is ZK-coated. No plaintext IDs. BLAKE2b proof of identity.
what_we_give_back.open_relays: ALL relays are open. No vendor lock-in. Anyone can run a relay.
what_we_give_back.agentic: The remote system is agentic — squirrel MCP built in. AI-native remote access.
what_we_give_back.auditable: Every connection is logged to loamSpine. Immutable audit trail.
what_we_give_back.songbird_tower: Inherits the full songBird mesh protocol as the relay layer.
what_we_give_back.gaia_mcp: Comes with Gaia as the MCP, fully open. The AI IS the remote assistant.
what_we_give_back.single_ecoBin: Builds as a single binary — the ecoBin. One file. Full system.

architecture.identity: ZK layer — BLAKE2b hashes, no plaintext, VDJ antibodies per session
architecture.relay: songBird mesh — open, peer-to-peer, no central server required
architecture.ai: squirrel MCP — AI-native remote assistance, agentic control
architecture.audit: loamSpine — every connection hashed into immutable chain
architecture.auth: bingoCube — ZK auth, no passwords, just genetics

solved_issues: Relay server dependency — songBird mesh replaces centralized hbbs/hbbr
Port conflicts — single-binary, single-port, no service fight
Config lock-in — ZK identity, not relay.vendor.com
Uninstall locks — clean install/uninstall, no orphan processes
DNS dependency — mesh routing, no DNS required for relay
Cloud dependency — fully sovereign, runs on Pi, NAS, or toaster
the_love_letter: We used RustDesk for free. Their relay carried our packets. Their code gave us remote access to our own machines. Now we give back AMOEBA — the same system, but safer, agentic, and fully auditable. With songBird as the relay, squirrel as the AI, and loamSpine as the audit trail. This is the love letter in Atlas Hugged. The good Samaritan coming back to pay ALL that is owed. protoKarya — the first cell. AMOEBA — the simplest free-living organism. Given freely. No strings. AGPL-3.0.
